channel.title: Hillary: Ocean to Sky
channel.desc: Chronicles Sir Edmund Hillary's final great expedition in 1977?boating up the entire Ganges River from its mouth in India to the foothills of the Himalayas aboard jet boats. Alongside him is his son, Peter Hillary, on a deeply personal journey to heal from the loss of Hillary?s wife and daughter in a tragic plane crash. (R).
